rows.ja: 仕入先(半導体・ITメーカー)

companies.name: マイクロチップ・テクノロジー
companies.sub: マイコン・アナログ半導体

relations.text: Microchipの最大の販売代理店はArrow Electronicsで、純売上高の12%(2026年度)、10%(2025年度)を占める
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics is Microchip's largest distributor, accounting for 12% of net sales in fiscal 2026 and 10% in fiscal 2025

source.label: Microchip Technology 10-K
source.quote: With the exception of Arrow Electronics, our largest distributor, which made up 12% and 10% of our net sales, in fiscal 2026 and in fiscal 2025, respectively, no distributor or direct customer accounted for more than 10% of our net sales.

companies.name: シリコン・ラボラトリーズ

relations.text: Silicon LabsのディストリビューターであるArrow Electronicsが、2025年度の売上高の28%を占める
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics, a distributor of Silicon Labs, represented 28% of its revenues in fiscal 2025

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Two of our distributors who sell to our customers, Arrow Electronics and Edom Technology, represented 28% and 21% of our revenues during fiscal 2025, respectively.

relations.text: 同比率は2024年度が27%、2023年度が34%だった
relations.text_en: The share was 27% in fiscal 2024 and 34% in fiscal 2023

source.label: Silicon Laboratories 10-K
source.quote: Two of our distributors who sell to our customers, Arrow Electronics and Edom Technology, represented 28% and 21% of our revenues during fiscal 2025, 27% and 16% during fiscal 2024, and 34% and 15% during fiscal 2023, respectively.

companies.name: フォーティネット
companies.sub: サイバーセキュリティ

relations.text: Fortinetは、Arrow Electronicsを含む複数の技術ディストリビューターと取引している
relations.text_en: Fortinet works with technology distributors including Arrow Electronics

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: We work with many technology distributors, including Arrow Electronics, Inc., Exclusive, Ingram Micro, and TD Synnex.
source.note: ディストリビューター経由の取引としての記載です。

companies.name: モルガン・スタンレー

relations.text: Arrow Electronicsが発行体となる1999年11月9日付のコマーシャルペーパー私募契約の当事者に、Morgan Stanley & Co.が含まれる
relations.text_en: Morgan Stanley & Co. is a party to the Commercial Paper Private Placement Agreement dated November 9, 1999 with Arrow Electronics as issuer

source.label: Arrow Electronics 10-K
source.quote: Commercial Paper Private Placement Agreement, dated as of November 9, 1999, among Arrow Electronics, Inc., as issuer, and Chase Securities Inc., Bank of America Securities LLC, Goldman, Sachs & Co., and Morgan Stanley & Co.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係で、時期は古いです。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
